name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for window seal replacement in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for window seal replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for window seal replacement in the Bay Area, look for companies with strong local references, proper licensing, and insurance. Inquire about their experience specifically with insulated glass unit replacements. Request detailed estimates and compare warranties offered on both labor and materials. A reputable contractor will conduct a thorough inspection before providing a quote and clearly explain the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a Bay Area contractor with local references, proper licensing, IGU replacement experience, and clear estimates.
